display.name: ClickHouse • All signals
display.description: Live standard OTel tables: metrics, logs, traces, profiles, histograms, exemplars, SQL annotations and dependent variables.

spec.query: SELECT DISTINCT ServiceName AS value FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND ServiceName != '' ORDER BY value

SELECT DISTINCT MetricName AS value FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY value

display.name: Native OTel metrics
display.description: Select a service and its dependent metric variable. Raw cumulative counters and up/down sums retain their OTel labels.

spec.query: SELECT * FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND MetricName = ${metric:sqlstring} AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

SELECT Timestamp, if(Body = '', EventName, Body) AS Body, SeverityText, ServiceName, TraceId, SpanId, ResourceAttributes, LogAttributes FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') GROUP BY TraceId ORDER BY max(Timestamp) DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY Timestamp

SELECT * FROM otel_traces WHERE TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') GROUP BY TraceId ORDER BY max(Timestamp) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY Timestamp

display.name: Native explicit histogram
display.description: Cart get latency. Native cumulative OTel bucket counts, not a rate.

spec.query: SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, MetricUnit, Count, Sum, ExplicitBounds, BucketCounts, Flags FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'demo.cart.get_cart.latency' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

display.name: Native histogram over time
display.description: Cart get latency. Native cumulative observations at their original collection timestamps.

spec.query: SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, MetricUnit, Count, Sum, ExplicitBounds, BucketCounts, Flags FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'demo.cart.get_cart.latency' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

display.name: Mean cart latency and trace exemplars
display.description: Mean of cumulative observations; exemplar points retain their measured duration and trace/span IDs.

spec.query: SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, MetricUnit, Sum / nullIf(Count, 0) AS Value, `Exemplars.Value`, `Exemplars.TimeUnix`, `Exemplars.TraceId`, `Exemplars.SpanId`, `Exemplars.FilteredAttributes` FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'demo.cart.get_cart.latency' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

display.name: Native exponential histogram
display.description: Real load-generator HTTP timings exported with the SDK's base-2 exponential histogram aggregation.

spec.query: SELECT TimeUnix, MetricName, MetricUnit, Count, Sum, Scale, ZeroCount, PositiveOffset, PositiveBucketCounts, NegativeOffset, NegativeBucketCounts, Flags FROM otel_metrics_exponential_histogram WHERE ServiceName = 'load-generator' AND MetricName = 'http.client.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND Attributes = (SELECT Attributes FROM otel_metrics_exponential_histogram WHERE ServiceName = 'load-generator' AND MetricName = 'http.client.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') GROUP BY Attributes ORDER BY count() DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY TimeUnix LIMIT 10000

display.name: Live eBPF profiles
display.description: Live Docker Linux VM eBPF samples, filtered by service and time; counts are not nanoseconds.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, SampleType, SampleUnit, FunctionNames, FileNames, LineNumbers, MappingFileNames, Addresses, Values, TimestampsUnixNano FROM otel_profiles WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND SampleType = 'samples' AND SampleUnit = 'count' AND Timestamp <= toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND Timestamp + toIntervalNanosecond(DurationNano) >= toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') ORDER BY Timestamp LIMIT 20000

SELECT toStartOfInterval(Timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS start, concat(toString(count()), ' application logs') AS title, ServiceName AS legend FROM otel_logs WHERE ServiceName = ${service:sqlstring} AND Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') GROUP BY start, ServiceName ORDER BY start LIMIT 100
